brief:
Israeli forces carried out multiple attacks across Gaza, including shelling that struck the Nuseirat refugee camp, according to Al Jazeera English. At least four Palestinians were killed in the strikes as military operations continued across the territory.

The Nuseirat camp, one of Gaza's eight refugee camps, was among the locations targeted during the assault. Further details on the specific circumstances of the attacks and the identities of those killed were not immediately available.
dek: Israel carried out several attacks in Gaza, including shelling the Nuseirat refugee camp.
title: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in Gaza
